pathways.title: Track day → club racing → national → BSB
stages: Track days — operator group riding at MSV, No Limits, circuit-run events. Build pace and circuit familiarity without a race licence
ACU CTC theory + BRA practical → Novice race licence. First races in Clubman Superstock or Formula 400 at club events (Bemsee, EMRA, NG, No Limits Racing)
Novice signatures → Clubman upgrade. Broader class entry; race in more competitive fields
Clubman → National licence. Enter national-level events; eligible for Superstock, Supersport supports
National → BSB support classes (National Sportbike, BMW Cup, Superstock 1000, Supersport). Compete on BSB weekend bills
BSB support → British Talent Cup shortlist or factory consideration → BSB main class or WorldSBK / MotoGP pathway

pathways.title: Short circuit → public-road events (Oliver's Mount / Manx GP / TT / NW200)
stages: Established club racing career with National or higher ACU licence
Oliver's Mount (Scarborough) — ACU-permitted road race circuit; good introduction to road race regulations
Manx Grand Prix — entry-level IOM Mountain Course event; no prior TT experience required; strict safety training and qualification laps
North West 200 — NI public-road race; MCUI licence; organisers review race history
Isle of Man TT — requires prior Manx GP or equivalent road racing experience; qualification laps; significant risk acceptance

pathways.title: Classic / historic pathway
stages: Classic track days and CRMC open days
CRMC club membership and racing — pre-1978 machine classes
National classic championships at Brands Hatch, Cadwell, Mallory, Snetterton, Donington, Oulton Park
International classic events (Goodwood Revival etc.) via specific invitation

pathways.title: Scottish pathway (SACU → Knockhill → national)
stages: SACU-affiliated club racing at Knockhill and East Fortune
Inter-association permission for ACU England/Wales events
ACU National licence for BSB support class entry
